<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/returns"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists the RMAs whose orderRef matches `orderRef`, by line number then
RMA id, one keyset page at a time (`limit` 1-500, default 100; `cursor` is the
opaque `nextCursor` of the previous page, absent on the last page;
repeat `orderRef` on every page request). An unknown order answers
`200` with `{"items":[]}`, never `404`. A malformed `limit` is 400
`invalid-limit`, an undecodable `cursor` is 400 `invalid-cursor`.
